name: Hancock Center

description: Hancock Center is a well-established community shopping destination strategically located at 1000 East 41st Street in central Austin, just minutes from downtown and the University of Texas campus. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this 245,628 square foot open-air center serves one of Austin's most densely populated and affluent neighborhoods, with convenient access off Interstate 35. The property is anchored by H.E.B., a beloved Texas grocery chain, and features a strong tenant mix including Twin Liquors, Petco, and 24 Hour Fitness, providing essential services and amenities for the local community. With over 4 million annual visits and a 4.4-star rating from more than 6,000 reviews, Hancock Center has established itself as a trusted neighborhood hub. The center's location in a trade area with household incomes averaging nearly $140,000 and home values exceeding $870,000 positions it as a premier shopping destination serving central Austin's discerning residents and the substantial daytime population drawn to the nearby university and downtown employment centers.
